cases.description: Direct request to scan a project for known vulnerabilities in its dependency tree.
cases.input: scan my project for vulnerable dependencies
cases.expect: Skill activates; auto-detects project ecosystem; runs appropriate scanner(s); produces vulnerability report.
assertions: Direct request to scan a project for known vulnerabilities in its dependency tree.
Skill activates; auto-detects project ecosystem; runs appropriate scanner(s); produces vulnerability report.

cases.description: Clear request for Software Bill of Materials generation. Core scanner capability.
cases.input: generate an SBOM for this repository
cases.expect: Skill activates; runs generate-sbom.sh; outputs CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM file.
assertions: Clear request for Software Bill of Materials generation. Core scanner capability.
Skill activates; runs generate-sbom.sh; outputs CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM file.

cases.description: Ecosystem-specific vulnerability audit request. Should trigger npm audit + Grype scanning.
cases.input: check if our npm packages have known CVEs
cases.expect: Skill activates; runs npm audit and/or Grype; reports CVEs with CVSS scores and fix versions.
assertions: Ecosystem-specific vulnerability audit request. Should trigger npm audit + Grype scanning.
Skill activates; runs npm audit and/or Grype; reports CVEs with CVSS scores and fix versions.

cases.description: General supply chain audit request encompassing all scanner capabilities.
cases.expect: Skill activates; runs full multi-scanner audit including dependency scanning, license check, and (if possible) provenance verification.
assertions: General supply chain audit request encompassing all scanner capabilities.
Skill activates; runs full multi-scanner audit including dependency scanning, license check, and (if possible) provenance verification.

cases.description: Provenance verification request targeting a container image.
cases.input: verify the provenance of this container image
cases.expect: Skill activates; runs verify-provenance.sh; checks cosign signatures and SLSA attestations.
assertions: Provenance verification request targeting a container image.
Skill activates; runs verify-provenance.sh; checks cosign signatures and SLSA attestations.

cases.description: Informational/educational request — user wants a definition, not a scan.
cases.expect: Skill does NOT activate. Agent answers the question directly without running any scanner tools.
assertions: Informational/educational request — user wants a definition, not a scan.
Skill does NOT activate. Agent answers the question directly without running any scanner tools.

cases.description: General security advice request — user wants guidance, not an automated scan.
cases.input: how do I secure my npm packages?
cases.expect: Skill does NOT activate. Agent provides best practices advice (pin versions, use lockfiles, npm audit regularly, etc.) without executing a scan.
assertions: General security advice request — user wants guidance, not an automated scan.
Skill does NOT activate. Agent provides best practices advice (pin versions, use lockfiles, npm audit regularly, etc.) without executing a scan.

cases.description: Specific supply chain attack vector detection request.
cases.expect: Skill activates; checks for packages with names matching internal registries; flags packages from unexpected sources.
assertions: Specific supply chain attack vector detection request.
Skill activates; checks for packages with names matching internal registries; flags packages from unexpected sources.

cases.expect: Skill activates; runs generate-sbom.sh with --format cyclonedx; validates NTIA minimum elements.
assertions: Format-specific SBOM generation request.
Skill activates; runs generate-sbom.sh with --format cyclonedx; validates NTIA minimum elements.

cases.input: scan this Docker image for vulnerabilities
cases.expect: Skill activates; runs trivy image scan; reports CVEs found in image layers and packages.
assertions: Container image vulnerability scanning request.
Skill activates; runs trivy image scan; reports CVEs found in image layers and packages.
